title.zh: 卷九 本紀第九 仁宗一
title.raw: 卷九 本紀第九 仁宗一 Volume 9 Annals 9: Renzong 1

sentences.zh: 仁宗體天法道極功全德神文聖武睿哲明孝皇帝，諱禎，初名受益，真宗第六子，母李宸妃也。

translations.literal: Emperor Renzong, entitled Aligning with Heaven, Patterning the Way, Utmost Merit, Complete Virtue, Divine Culture, Sagely Martiality, Sagacious Governance, Bright Filiality, taboo name Zhen, original name Shouyi, was the sixth son of Emperor Zhenzong; his mother was Lady Li, the Talented Consort.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Renzong—full style from Aligning with Heaven through Bright Filiality—personal name Zhen, born Shouyi, was Zhenzong’s sixth son; his mother was Lady Li of the Talented Consort rank.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符三年四月十四日生。

translations.literal: He was born on the fourteenth day of the fourth month of the third year of Great Central Auspice.
translations.idiomatic: He was born on the fourteenth of the fourth month, Great Central Auspice year three.

sentences.zh: 章獻皇后無子，取為己子養之。

translations.literal: Empress Zhangxian had no son; she took him and raised him as her own.
translations.idiomatic: Childless Empress Zhangxian adopted him and raised him as her son.

sentences.zh: 天性仁孝寬裕，喜慍不形於色。

translations.literal: By nature he was benevolent, filial, and magnanimous; pleasure and anger did not show on his face.
translations.idiomatic: He was naturally kind, filial, and even-tempered—joy and anger never showed on his face.

sentences.zh: 七年，封慶國公。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was enfeoffed Duke of Qing.
translations.idiomatic: In year seven he became Duke of Qing.

sentences.zh: 八年，封壽春郡王，講學於資善堂。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was enfeoffed Prince of Shouchun and studied in the Hall of Cultivating Goodness.
translations.idiomatic: In year eight he became Prince of Shouchun and studied in the Hall of Cultivating Goodness.

sentences.zh: 天禧元年，兼中書令。

translations.literal: In the first year of Heavenly Blessing he was made concurrent director of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Heavenly Blessing year one brought him a concurrent Secretariat-Chancellery post.

sentences.zh: 明年，進封升王。

translations.literal: The next year he was advanced to Prince of Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was raised to Prince of Sheng.

sentences.zh: 九月丁卯，冊為皇太子，以參知政事李迪兼太子賓客。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingmao: he was enfeoffed as crown prince; Participating Administrator Li Di was made concurrent prince’s mentor.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, dingmao: he was made crown prince; Li Di became his mentor as councilor.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，謁太廟。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: the imperial temple was visited.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, he worshipped at the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 四年，詔五日一開資善堂，太子秉笏南鄉立，聽輔臣參決諸司事。

translations.literal: Year four, edict: every five days the Hall of Cultivating Goodness was opened; the prince held his tablet and stood facing south while tutor-ministers decided affairs of the departments.
translations.idiomatic: Year four: the prince held court in the Hall of Cultivating Goodness every five days, standing south with tablet while tutors ruled on departmental business.

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉，作受命寶。

translations.literal: Third month, day yiyou: the Mandate-receiving seal was made.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, yiyou: the Mandate-receiving seal was cast.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，初御崇德殿，太后設幄次於承明殿，垂簾以見輔臣。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: for the first time he held court in Chongde Hall; the empress dowager set a screen at Chenming Hall and held the curtain to receive tutor-ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, he first sat in Chongde Hall while the dowager screened Chenming Hall and heard ministers behind the curtain.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬子，遣使以即位告契丹。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day renzi: envoys were sent to announce the accession to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, renzi: envoys told the Khitan of the new reign.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，交州來貢。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Jiaozhou came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Jiaozhou sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 五月乙亥，錄系囚，雜犯死罪遞降一等，杖以下釋之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yihai: prisoners were reviewed; mixed offenses below death were reduced one degree; those below the rod were released.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, yihai: a prison review cut mixed crimes below capital one grade and freed those due only flogging.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，命參知政事王曾按視山陵皇堂。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiyou: Participating Administrator Wang Zeng was ordered to inspect the mountain tomb’s central chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiyou: Wang Zeng inspected the imperial tomb’s central chamber.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，契丹使來祭奠吊慰。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Khitan envoys came to mourn and console.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Khitan envoys arrived to mourn.

sentences.zh: 庚申，入內內侍省押班雷允恭坐擅移皇堂伏誅。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Lei Yungong, duty officer of the inner palace service bureau, was executed for moving the central chamber without authorization.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, inner-palace officer Lei Yungong was executed for relocating the tomb chamber without leave.

sentences.zh: 丁謂罷為太子少保、分司西京。

translations.literal: Ding Wei was removed as prince’s junior mentor and made honorary western capital official.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Wei was demoted to prince’s junior mentor and sent to the western capital.

sentences.zh: 甲子，改命馮拯為山陵使。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Feng Zheng was renamed mountain-tomb commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Feng Zheng replaced him as tomb commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，降參知政事任中正為太子賓客。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Participating Administrator Ren Zhongzheng was demoted to prince’s mentor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Ren Zhongzheng was lowered to prince’s mentor.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未，馮拯加昭文館大學士，王曾為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事、集賢殿大學士，呂夷簡、魯宗道參知政事。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinwei: Feng Zheng was made grand academician of the Zhaowen Hall; Wang Zeng became vice director of the Secretariat and co-director of the Secretariat-Chancellery and grand academician of the Jixian Hall; Lü Yijian and Lu Zongdao became participating administrators.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, xinwei: Feng Zheng took Zhaowen grand academician; Wang Zeng became vice director and co-chancellor with Jixian rank; Lü Yijian and Lu Zongdao joined the council.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，遣使報謝契丹。

translations.literal: Day yihai: envoys were sent to thank the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, thank-you envoys went to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 丙子，樞密副使錢惟演為樞密使。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Vice military affairs commissioner Qian Weiyan became military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Qian Weiyan became military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，改翼祖定陵為靖陵。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Ancestor Yi’s Ding tomb was renamed Jing tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Ancestor Yi’s Ding tomb was renamed Jing.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，貶丁謂為崖州司戶參軍。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Ding Wei was demoted to census adjutant of Yazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Ding Wei was banished as Yazhou census adjutant.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，遣使賀契丹主及其妻生日、正旦。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renyin: envoys were sent to congratulate the Khitan ruler and his consort on birthdays and New Year.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, renyin: envoys congratulated the Khitan emperor and empress on birthdays and New Year.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，皇太后同御承明殿垂簾決事。

translations.literal: Day yisi: the empress dowager jointly held court at Chenming Hall behind the curtain to decide affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, the dowager joined him at Chenming Hall to rule from behind the curtain.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申，告大行皇帝諡于天地、宗廟、社稷。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renshen: the late emperor’s posthumous title was announced to Heaven, Earth, the ancestral temple, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, renshen: Zhenzong’s posthumous style was proclaimed to Heaven, Earth, temple, and altars.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，上諡冊于延慶殿。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: the posthumous register was presented at Yanqing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the posthumous register was offered at Yanqing Hall.

sentences.zh: 己卯，命以天書從葬。

translations.literal: Day jimao: orders were given to bury the Heavenly Book with the deceased.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, the Heavenly Book was ordered buried with the late emperor.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬寅，契丹使來賀即位。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renyin: Khitan envoys came to congratulate the accession.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, renyin: Khitan envoys congratulated the new reign.

sentences.zh: 己酉，葬真宗皇帝于永定陵。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Emperor Zhenzong was buried at Yongding tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Zhenzong was interred at Yongding tomb.

sentences.zh: 詔中外避皇太后父諱。

translations.literal: An edict ordered court and country to avoid the empress dowager’s father’s name.
translations.idiomatic: Court and realm were ordered to avoid the dowager’s father’s personal name.

sentences.zh: 己未，祔真宗神主於太廟，廟樂曰《大明之舞》，以莊穆皇后配。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Zhenzong’s spirit tablet was enshrined in the imperial temple; temple music was titled “Dance of Great Brightness,” with Empress Zhuangmu as consort.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Zhenzong entered the ancestral temple to the dance Great Brightness, paired with Empress Zhuangmu.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，降東、西京囚罪一等，杖以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: eastern and western capital prisoners were reduced one degree; those below the rod were released.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Luoyang and Kaifeng prisoners were cut one grade; flogging cases freed.

sentences.zh: 蠲山陵役戶及靈駕所過民田租。

translations.literal: Corvée households for the tomb and land tax on fields the imperial procession passed were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Tomb laborers and farmers along the funeral route received tax relief.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁卯朔，錢惟演罷。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingmao new moon: Qian Weiyan was removed.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, new moon dingmao: Qian Weiyan was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，唃廝囉、立遵求內附。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Gusiluo and Lizon sought to submit inward.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Gusiluo and Lizon asked to come in.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以皇太后生日為長寧節。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the empress dowager’s birthday was made the Long Peace festival.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the dowager’s birthday became the Long Peace festival.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，初御崇政殿西閣講筵，命侍講孫奭、馮元講《論語》。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: for the first time the western wing of Chongde Hall held the lecture; Reader Sun Shi and Feng Yuan were ordered to lecture the Analects.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Chongde’s west wing opened its lecture; Sun Shi and Feng Yuan expounded the Analects.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以張知白為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Zhang Zhibai was made vice military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Zhang Zhibai became vice military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬戌，契丹使來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renxu: Khitan envoys came to congratulate the coming New Year.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, renxu: Khitan envoys came for New Year.

sentences.zh: 是歲，蘇州水，滄州海潮溢，詔振恤被水及溺死之家。

translations.literal: That year, Suzhou suffered flood; Cangzhou’s sea tide overflowed; an edict ordered relief for flooded and drowned households.
translations.idiomatic: That year floods hit Suzhou and tides drowned Cangzhou—relief was ordered for victims.

sentences.zh: 南平王李公蘊遣使進貢。

translations.literal: Prince of Nanping Li Gongyun sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Nanping’s Li Gongyun sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 天聖元年春正月丙寅朔，改元。

translations.literal: Heavenly Sage year one, spring, first month, day bingyin new moon: the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: Heavenly Sage 1, new moon bingyin: a new reign title began.

sentences.zh: 庚午，契丹使初來賀長寧節。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Khitan envoys came for the first time to congratulate the Long Peace festival.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Khitan envoys first came for the Long Peace festival.

sentences.zh: 癸未，命三司節浮費，遂立計置司。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: the three departments were ordered to cut extravagant spending; a planning office was then established.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the three departments were told to curb waste and a planning office was set up.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以京東、淮南水災，遣使安撫。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: because of floods in eastern Jing and Huainan, envoys were sent to comfort.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, eastern Jing and Huainan floods brought comfort envoys.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，發卒增築京城。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: corvée troops were sent to enlarge and repair the capital walls.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, laborers were drafted to heighten the capital walls.

sentences.zh: 二月戊戌，許唃廝囉歲一入貢。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuxu: Gusiluo was permitted one tribute mission per year.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, wuxu: Gusiluo was limited to one annual tribute visit.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，奉安太祖、太宗御容于南京鴻慶宮。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Taizu and Taizong’s imperial portraits were installed at Hongqing Palace in the southern capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Taizu and Taizong’s portraits were enshrined at Nanjing’s Hongqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，減諸節齋醮道場。

translations.literal: Day renxu: fasting altars for the festival days were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, festival-day Daoist altars were cut back.

sentences.zh: 三月甲戌，奉安真宗御容于西京應天院。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiaxu: Zhenzong’s portrait was installed at Yingtian Court in the western capital.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiaxu: Zhenzong’s portrait went to Luoyang’s Yingtian Court.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔減西京囚罪一等，徒以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day bingzi, edict: western capital prisoners were reduced one degree; penal servitude and below were released.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Luoyang prisoners were cut one grade; exile and below freed.

sentences.zh: 賜城中民八十以上者茶帛，仍復其家。

translations.literal: City residents eighty and above were given tea and cloth and their households were exempted.
translations.idiomatic: Capital residents over eighty received tea, cloth, and household exemptions.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔自今營造，三司度實給用。

translations.literal: Day jiashen, edict: from now on in construction the three departments were to measure real need and supply accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, all new building was to be budgeted on actual need.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，司天監上《崇天曆》。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: the Directorate of Astronomy presented the Chongtian calendar.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, astronomers submitted the Chongtian calendar.

sentences.zh: 行淮南十三山場貼射茶法。

translations.literal: The Huainan thirteen mountain-factory targeted tea-sale law was implemented.
translations.idiomatic: Huainan’s thirteen mountain tea depots switched to targeted sales rules.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛丑，罷禮儀院。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinchou: the Court of Ritual was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, xinchou: the standalone ritual court was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁未，乾元節，百官及契丹使初上壽於崇德殿。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: on the Qianyuan festival, officials and Khitan envoys for the first time offered longevity wishes in Chongde Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Qianyuan brought the first longevity rites in Chongde with Khitan envoys present.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔文武官奏蔭親屬從本資。

translations.literal: Day guichou, edict: when officials memorialized kin for yin privilege, rank followed original qualification.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, yin appointments were to follow the sponsor’s original rank, not inflated titles.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔近臣舉諫官、御史各一人。

translations.literal: Day dingsi, edict: close officials were each to recommend one remonstrator or censor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, each intimate minister was to name one remonstrator or censor.

sentences.zh: 五月甲子，行陝西、河北入中芻糧見錢法。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiazi: the Shaanxi and Hebei cash-for-fodder delivery law was implemented.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jiazi: Shaanxi and Hebei began paying cash for delivered fodder.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔禮部貢舉。

translations.literal: Day gengwu, edict: the Ministry of Rites civil examination.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the Ministry of Rites examination was ordered.

sentences.zh: 辛未，錄系囚。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，命魯宗道按視滑州決河。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Lu Zongdao was ordered to inspect the Yellow River breach at Hua prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Lu Zongdao was sent to inspect Hua’s river breach.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，議皇太后儀衛制同乘輿。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: the empress dowager’s guard and insignia were debated as equal to the imperial carriage.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, court debated giving the dowager imperial escort and regalia.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰，罷江甯府溧水縣采丹砂。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiachen: cinnabar mining at Lishui county, Jiangning prefecture, was halted.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiachen: Jiangning’s Lishui cinnabar mines were closed.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，禁毀錢鑄鐘。

translations.literal: Day yimao: destroying cash to cast bells was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, melting coin for bells was banned.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬申，除戎、瀘州虛估稅錢。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renshen: fictitious valuation tax money at Rong and Lu prefectures was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, renshen: inflated valuation taxes at Rong and Lu were abolished.

sentences.zh: 詔職田遇水旱蠲租如例。

translations.literal: Edict: office fields encountering flood or drought were to have rent remitted as usual.
translations.idiomatic: Official fields hit by flood or drought received the usual rent holidays.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，蠲天下逋負。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: arrears owed the state throughout the empire were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, empire-wide tax arrears were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 八月乙未，募民輸芟塞滑州決河。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yiwei: the people were recruited to deliver brush for blocking Hua’s river breach.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, yiwei: civilians were hired to supply brush for Hua’s levee.

sentences.zh: 丙申，下德音，減天下囚罪一等，杖以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: a lenient edict was issued; crimes empire-wide were reduced one degree; those below the rod were released.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, a lenient edict cut crimes one grade and freed flogging cases.

sentences.zh: 廢鄆州東平馬監，以牧地賦民。

translations.literal: Yanzhou’s eastern Ping horse stud was abolished and pasture given to the people.
translations.idiomatic: Yanzhou’s eastern horse stud was closed and its pasture distributed to farmers.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，芝生天安殿柱。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: auspicious fungus grew on a pillar of Tian’an Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, spirit fungus appeared on a Tian’an Hall pillar.

sentences.zh: 九月丙寅，馮拯罷，以王欽若為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事、昭文館大學士。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingyin: Feng Zheng was removed; Wang Qinruo was made vice director of the Chancellery, co-director of the Secretariat-Chancellery, and grand academician of the Zhaowen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, bingyin: Feng Zheng fell; Wang Qinruo became vice chancellor with Zhaowen grand academician rank.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔凡舉官未改轉而坐贓者，舉主免劾。

translations.literal: Day xinsi, edict: when a recommended official who had not yet been promoted was convicted of graft, the recommender was exempt from impeachment.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, sponsors were shielded from blame if a nominee took bribes before promotion.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，宴崇德殿。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: a feast was held in Chongde Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Chongde Hall hosted a banquet.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲午，詔裁造院女工及營婦配南北作坊者，並釋之。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day jiawu, edict: craftswomen of the tailoring office and camp wives assigned to north and south workshops were all released.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, jiawu: imperial workshop women and camp wives in factories were freed.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，寇准卒于雷州。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Kou Zhun died at Lei prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Kou Zhun died in exile at Lei.

sentences.zh: 己亥，馮拯卒。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Feng Zheng died.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Feng Zheng died.

sentences.zh: 丁未，禁彭州九隴縣採金。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: gold mining at Jiulong county, Peng prefecture, was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Peng’s Jiulong gold mines were banned.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，禁伎術官求輔臣、宗室薦舉。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: technical officials were forbidden to seek recommendation from tutor-ministers or the imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, technical officers could no longer solicit clan or minister sponsorship.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛酉朔，徙陝西緣邊軍馬屯內地。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinyou new moon: Shaanxi frontier horses and troops were moved to the interior.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, new moon xinyou: Shaanxi border cavalry were shifted inland.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁酉，詔諸州配囚，錄具獄與地裏，上尚書刑部詳覆。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingyou, edict: when assigning convicts to prefectures, full case records and native place were to be filed and sent to the Ministry of Justice for review.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, dingyou: convict assignments required full dossiers to the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 禁兩浙、江南、荊湖、福建、廣南路巫覡挾邪術害人者。

translations.literal: Shamans of the two Zhes, Jiangnan, Jinghu, Fujian, and Guangnan circuits who used heterodox arts to harm people were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Harmful shamans in the southeast circuits were outlawed.

sentences.zh: 戊午，置益州交子務。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: the Yizhou paper-money office was established.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Yizhou’s paper-money bureau opened.

sentences.zh: 是歲，甘、沙州來貢，涇原咩迷卞杏家族納質內附。

translations.literal: That year, Gan and Shazhou came to tribute; the Maimi and Benxing clans of Jingyuan gave hostages and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute came from Gan and Sha; Jingyuan’s Maimi and Benxing clans gave hostages.

sentences.zh: 二年春二月庚午，遣內臣收瘞汴口流屍，仍祭奠之。

translations.literal: Year two, spring, second month, day gengwu: eunuchs were sent to gather and bury corpses at the Bian estuary and perform sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Year two, second month, gengwu: eunuchs buried Bian estuary dead and offered rites.

sentences.zh: 三月丁酉，奉安真宗御容于景靈宮奉真殿。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingyou: Zhenzong’s portrait was installed in the Spirit-Truth hall of Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, dingyou: Zhenzong’s portrait entered Jingling’s Spirit-Truth hall.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，王欽若上《真宗實錄》。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Wang Qinruo presented the Veritable Records of Zhenzong.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Wang Qinruo submitted Zhenzong’s Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 是月，賜禮部奏名進士、諸秋及第出身四百八十五人。

translations.literal: That month, 485 men who passed the Ministry of Rites examination and various autumn cohorts were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: That month, 485 examination graduates received court honors.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛酉，詔三司歲市紬、絹非土產者罷之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinyou, edict: annual purchases of silk not local products were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, xinyou: the three departments stopped buying non-local silks.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，錄晉石氏後。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: descendants of the Jin house of Shi were enrolled.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Jin dynasty Shi descendants were registered.

sentences.zh: 五月乙未，錄系囚。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yiwei: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, yiwei: prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 六月壬申。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renshen.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, renshen.

sentences.zh: 罷天慶、天祺、天貺、先天、降聖節宮觀然燈。

translations.literal: Lamp offerings at palace observances for the Heavenly Celebration, Heavenly Auspice, Heavenly Gift, Primal Heaven, and Descent of Sage festivals were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Festival lamps at Heavenly Celebration, Heavenly Auspice, Heavenly Gift, Primal Heaven, and Descent of Sage shrines were ended.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸丑，奉安真宗御容於玉清昭應宮安聖殿。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guichou: Zhenzong’s imperial portrait was installed in the Peaceful Sage hall of the Jade Pure Manifest Response Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, guichou: Zhenzong’s portrait entered the Peaceful Sage hall at Jade Pure Manifest Response.

sentences.zh: 八月丙辰朔，宴崇德殿，初用樂之半。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingchen new moon: a feast was held in Chongde Hall, using half the full music for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, new moon bingchen: Chongde Hall feasted with half the usual orchestra— a first.

sentences.zh: 詔舉官己遷改而貪污者，舉主以狀聞，聞而不以實者坐之。

translations.literal: Edict: when a recommended official who had already been promoted was convicted of graft, the recommender was to report in a memorial; those who reported falsely were punished.
translations.idiomatic: Sponsors had to report graft by promoted nominees; false reports brought punishment on the sponsor.

sentences.zh: 己卯，幸國子監，謁孔子，遂幸武成王廟。

translations.literal: Day jimao: he visited the Directorate of Education, paid homage to Confucius, then visited the Marquis Wu temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he worshipped at the imperial academy and the temple of Marquis Wu.

sentences.zh: 甲申，太白入太微垣。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Venus entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Venus crossed into the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，祠太一宮，賜道左耕者茶帛。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinmao: the Grand Unity Palace was sacrificed to; tea and cloth were given to farmers along the road.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, xinmao: he sacrificed at Grand Unity Palace and gave tea and cloth to roadside farmers.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙辰，奉安真宗御容于洪福院。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingchen: Zhenzong’s portrait was installed at Hongfu Court.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, bingchen: Zhenzong’s portrait was enshrined at Hongfu Court.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午，加上真宗諡。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiawu: Zhenzong’s posthumous title was augmented.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jiawu: Zhenzong received an augmented posthumous title.

sentences.zh: 乙未，朝饗玉清昭應、景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: morning offerings were made at Jade Pure Manifest Response and Spirit-Numinous palaces.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, morning rites were held at Jade Pure and Spirit-Numinous palaces.

sentences.zh: 丙申，饗太廟。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: the ancestral temple was feasted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the imperial ancestors were feasted.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，祀天地於圜丘，大赦。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to at the round altar; a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to at the round altar and the realm was amnestied.

sentences.zh: 百官上尊號曰聖文睿武仁明孝德皇帝，上皇太后尊號曰應元崇德仁壽慈聖皇太后。

translations.literal: Officials offered the honorific Sagely Culture, Sagacious Martiality, Humane Brightness, Filial Virtue Emperor; the empress dowager was given the honorific Responding to the Primal, Honoring Virtue, Benevolent Longevity, Merciful Sagely Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: The court styled him Sagely Culture, Sagacious Martiality, Humane Brightness, Filial Virtue Emperor and the dowager Responding to the Primal, Honoring Virtue, Benevolent Longevity, Merciful Sagely Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 賜百官諸軍加等。

translations.literal: Officials and the armies were given added rank grades.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military ranks received a bonus grade.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，立皇后郭氏。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Empress Guo was installed.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Lady Guo became empress.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，加恩百官。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: added favors were bestowed on officials.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, officials received an extra round of favors.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午，詔開封府每歲正旦、冬至禁刑三日。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengwu, edict: Kaifeng prefecture was each year to forbid punishments for three days at New Year and the winter solstice.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, gengwu: Kaifeng was barred from executions for three days at New Year and winter solstice.

sentences.zh: 是歲，龜茲、甘肅來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Kucha and Ganzhou came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Kucha and Ganzhou sent tribute that year.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月辛卯，長寧節，近臣及契丹使初上皇太后壽于崇政殿。

translations.literal: Year three, spring, first month, day xinmao: on the Long Peace festival, close officials and Khitan envoys for the first time offered longevity wishes to the empress dowager in Chongzheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Year three, first month, xinmao: Long Peace brought the first dowager longevity rites in Chongzheng with Khitan envoys present.

sentences.zh: 二月戊寅，詔陝西災傷州軍，盜廩穀非傷主者，刺配鄰州牢城，徒減一等。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuyin, edict: in Shaanxi disaster prefectures, theft of granary grain without injury to the owner was tattooed and sent to a neighboring fortress army; penal servitude was reduced one degree.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, wuyin: Shaanxi granary thieves who did not harm owners were tattooed into frontier garrisons; exile sentences dropped one grade.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁丑，詔三館繕書藏太清樓。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingchou, edict: the three institutes were to repair books and store them in the Great Clarity tower.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, dingchou: the three institutes were ordered to bind books for the Great Clarity tower.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅，錄系囚。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengyin: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, gengyin: the court reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，幸御莊觀刈麥，聞民舍機杼聲，賜織婦茶帛。

translations.literal: Day guisi: he visited the imperial estate to watch the wheat harvest, heard loom sounds from a farmhouse, and gave tea and cloth to weaving women.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, watching the harvest at the imperial farm, he heard a loom and rewarded the weaver with tea and cloth.

sentences.zh: 己亥，賜隱士林逋粟帛。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the recluse Lin Bu was given grain and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the hermit Lin Bu received grain and cloth.

sentences.zh: 己酉，禁臣僚奏薦無服子弟。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: officials were forbidden to memorialize recommending collaterals within the mourning circle.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, ministers could no longer sponsor distant kin within the mourning circle.

sentences.zh: 六月壬戌，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renxu: Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, renxu: Venus appeared by day.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，環、原州屬羌叛寇邊，環慶都監趙士隆等死之，遣使者安撫陝西。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Qiang dependent on Huan and Yuan prefectures rebelled and raided the border; Huanqing superintendent Zhao Shilong and others died; envoys were sent to comfort Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Huan and Yuan Qiang rose; Zhao Shilong and other border officers fell; Shaanxi received comfort envoys.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊子，詔諸路轉運使察舉知州、通判不任事者。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuzi, edict: circuit transport commissioners were to investigate and report prefects and vice-prefects who were incompetent.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, wuzi: transport commissioners were to expose incompetent prefects and vice-prefects.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔邊戶為羌所擾者蠲租，復役二年。

translations.literal: Day bingwu, edict: frontier households harassed by Qiang were to have rent remitted and corvée restored for two years.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Qiang-harried frontier households got two years’ rent relief and corvée rest.

sentences.zh: 八月戊午，以忠州鹽井歲增課、夔州奉節巫山縣舊藉民為營田、萬州戶有稅者歲糴其穀，皆為民害，詔悉除之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuwu: because the Zhongzhou salt wells’ annual levy increase, Fengjie county of Kuizhou’s old practice of registering people for military farms, and Wanzhou households taxed yearly for government grain purchase were all harmful to the people, an edict abolished them all.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, salt levies at Zhong, Kuizhou’s forced farm registration, and Wanzhou’s compulsory grain sales were all scrapped as abuses.

sentences.zh: 辛未，蠲陝西州軍旱災租賦。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Shaanxi circuit rents and taxes from drought disaster were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, drought-struck Shaanxi circuits were freed from rent and tax.

sentences.zh: 九月乙巳，詔司天監奏災異據占書以聞。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yisi, edict: the Directorate of Astronomy was to report omens and disasters according to prognostication texts.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, yisi: astronomers had to report omens by the classical prognostication books.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙卯，太白犯南斗。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yimao: Venus transgressed the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, yimao: Venus crossed the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，晏殊為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Yan Shu became vice military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Yan Shu became vice military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十一月己卯朔，罷貼射茶法。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jimao new moon: the targeted tea-sale law was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, new moon jimao: targeted tea sales were abolished.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以襄州水蠲民租。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: because of Xiangzhou flood, people’s rent was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Xiangzhou flood victims were freed from rent.

sentences.zh: 晉、絳、陝、解州饑，發粟振之。

translations.literal: Jin, Jiang, Shaan, and Xie prefectures suffered famine; grain was issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Famine in Jin, Jiang, Shaan, and Xie brought grain relief.

sentences.zh: 戊申，王欽若卒。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Wang Qinruo died.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Wang Qinruo died.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸丑，王曾為門下侍郎、昭文館大學士，張知白同中書門下平章事、集賢殿大學士。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guichou: Wang Zeng was made vice director of the Chancellery and grand academician of the Zhaowen Hall; Zhang Zhibai was made co-director of the Secretariat-Chancellery and grand academician of the Jixian Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, guichou: Wang Zeng became vice chancellor with Zhaowen rank; Zhang Zhibai joined the council with Jixian rank.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，張旻為樞密使。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Zhang Min became military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Zhang Min became military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Venus appeared by day again.

sentences.zh: 是歲，龜茲、甘州、于闐來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Kucha, Ganzhou, and Khotan came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Kucha, Ganzhou, and Khotan sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 環、慶蕃部嵬逋等內附。

translations.literal: Fan tribes of Huan and Qing, including Weibo, submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: Huan and Qing tribes led by Weibo came in.

sentences.zh: 補涇原降羌首領潘征為本族軍主。

translations.literal: The surrendered Qiang leader Pan Zheng of Jingyuan was appointed military chief of his tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Jingyuan’s surrendered Qiang chief Pan Zheng was made tribal military chief.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月己亥，命章得象與流內銓同試百司人。

translations.literal: Year four, spring, first month, day jihai: Zhang Dexiang was ordered to examine hundred-offices personnel jointly with the flowing-within selection office.
translations.idiomatic: First month, jihai: Zhang Dexiang and the flowing-within office jointly examined hundred-offices candidates.

sentences.zh: 庚子，涇原兵破康奴族。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Jingyuan troops defeated the Kangnu tribe.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Jingyuan forces broke the Kangnu.

sentences.zh: 二月甲寅，詔吏犯贓至流，按察官失舉者，並劾之。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiayin, edict: when officials guilty of graft reached exile, investigating commissioners who failed to expose them were also impeached.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jiayin: investigators who missed graft cases up to exile were impeached with the guilty.

sentences.zh: 庚午，置西界和市場。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: western-border harmony markets were established.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, trade markets opened on the western border.

sentences.zh: 三月甲申，詔轉運使、提點刑獄罷勸農司。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiashen, edict: transport commissioners and judicial intendant-commissioners were to abolish the encourage-agriculture offices.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiashen: transport and judicial commissioners shut encourage-agriculture offices.

sentences.zh: 己亥，鄜延蕃部首領曹守貴等內附。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Fan chieftains of Yan and Yan circuits, including Cao Shougui, submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Yan circuit chieftains led by Cao Shougui submitted.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬子，詔京東西、河北、淮南平谷價。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day renzi, edict: grain prices in eastern and western Jing, Hebei, and Huainan were to be stabilized.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, renzi: eastern and western Jing, Hebei, and Huainan were ordered to stabilize grain prices.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，詔禮部貢舉。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jimao, edict: the Ministry of Rites civil examination.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jimao: the Ministry of Rites examination was ordered.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔大辟疑者奏讞，有司毋輒舉駁。

translations.literal: Day renwu, edict: doubtful capital cases were to be memorialized for review; the departments were not to reject casually.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, doubtful death sentences had to be memorialized; agencies could not casually reject them.

sentences.zh: 戊子，錄系囚。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔士有文而行不副者，州郡毋得薦送。

translations.literal: Day jihai, edict: scholars with literary talent but conduct unworthy were not to be recommended by prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, prefectures could not forward scholars whose conduct failed their learning.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊申，減江、淮歲漕米五十萬石。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day wushen: Jiang-Huai annual transport grain was reduced by five hundred thousand piculs.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, wushen: Jiang-Huai grain transport was cut by five hundred thousand piculs.

sentences.zh: 除舒州太湖等九茶場民逋錢十三萬緡。

translations.literal: Arrears owed by people at nine tea factories including Taihu in Shuzhou, thirteen myriads of strings, were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Shuzhou’s nine tea factories, including Taihu, were forgiven thirteen myriads of strings in arrears.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔補太廟室長、齋郎。

translations.literal: Day jiyou, edict: temple chamber chiefs and fast-day officers were to be supplemented.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, ancestral temple chamber chiefs and fast officers were to be filled.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，復陝西永豐渠以通解鹽。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Shaanxi’s Yongfeng canal was restored to transport Jie salt.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Shaanxi’s Yongfeng canal reopened for Jie salt.

sentences.zh: 六月丁亥，建、劍、邵武等州軍大水，詔賜被災家米二石，溺死者官瘞之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dinghai: Jian, Jian, and Shaowu circuits suffered great flood; an edict gave two piculs of rice to each disaster household and ordered official burial for the drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, dinghai: floods in Fujian circuits brought two piculs per household and state burial for the drowned.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，大雨震電，京師平地水數尺。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: great rain, thunder, and lightning; water in the capital flatlands reached several feet.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, thunderstorms left several feet of water in the capital streets.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，避正殿，減常膳。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: he avoided the main hall and reduced his regular meals.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, he left the main hall and cut court meals.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，降天下囚罪一等，徒以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: crimes empire-wide were reduced one degree; penal servitude and below were released.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, empire-wide sentences dropped one grade; exile and below were freed.

sentences.zh: 畿內、京東西、淮南、河北被水民田蠲其租。

translations.literal: Rent on flooded farmland in the capital region, eastern and western Jing, Huainan, and Hebei was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Flooded fields in the capital region, Jing, Huainan, and Hebei were freed from rent.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔官物漂失，主典免償。

translations.literal: Day guimao, edict: when government goods were lost in drifting, the responsible clerk was exempt from compensation.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, clerks were not liable for goods lost in flood drift.

sentences.zh: 流徙者，所在撫存之。

translations.literal: Those in exile or banishment were to be comforted and sustained wherever they were.
translations.idiomatic: Exiles and banishees were to be comforted in place.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊申，御長春殿，復常膳。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wushen: he presided in Everlasting Spring Hall and restored regular meals.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, wushen: he returned to Everlasting Spring Hall and normal meals.

sentences.zh: 辛未，減兩川歲輸錦綺，易綾紗為絹，以給邊費。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: the two Sichuan circuits’ annual delivery of brocades and silks was reduced; gauze and damask were changed to plain silk to supply frontier expenses.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Sichuan’s brocade tribute was cut and gauze converted to plain silk for the frontier.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔諸路轉運使舉所部官通經術者。

translations.literal: Day renshen, edict: circuit transport commissioners were to recommend officials in their jurisdictions versed in the classics.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, transport commissioners had to name classicist officials under them.

sentences.zh: 八月丁亥，築泰州捍海堰。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dinghai: a sea-bank was built at Taizhou to repel the tide.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, dinghai: Taizhou raised a sea wall against the tide.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔施州溪峒首領三年一至京師。

translations.literal: Day jichou, edict: stream-cave chieftains of Shizhou were to come to the capital once every three years.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Shizhou cave chiefs were limited to one capital visit every three years.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯，詔孫奭、馮元舉京朝官通經術者。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yimao, edict: Sun Shi and Feng Yuan were to recommend capital officials versed in the classics.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, yimao: Sun Shi and Feng Yuan were to name classicist capital officials.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔禮部貢院：諸科通三經者薦擢之。

translations.literal: Day gengshen, edict to the Ministry of Rites examination yard: candidates in various subjects who mastered three classics were to be recommended for promotion.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, examination candidates who mastered three classics were to be fast-tracked.

sentences.zh: 錄周世宗從孫柴元亨為三班奉職。

translations.literal: Chai Yuanheng, collateral descendant of Later Zhou Shizong, was enrolled as third-rank attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Later Zhou Shizong’s collateral descendant Chai Yuanheng was made third-rank attendant.

sentences.zh: 辛未，廢襄、唐州營田務，以田賦民。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: military farm offices of Xiang and Tang prefectures were abolished and the land taxed to the people.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Xiang and Tang military farms were closed and the land returned to farmers.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiaxu new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, new moon jiaxu: a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔郎中以上致仕，賜一子官。

translations.literal: Day renchen, edict: officials of langzhong rank and above who retired were to have one son given office.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, retiring officials of langzhong rank and above could grant one son office.

sentences.zh: 甲午，昏霧四塞。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: dim mist filled the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, thick haze blanketed the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙申，奉安真宗御容于鴻慶宮。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Zhenzong’s portrait was installed at Hongqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Zhenzong’s portrait entered Hongqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁丑，發米六十萬斛貸畿內饑。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingchou: six hundred thousand hu of rice were issued on loan to the famine-stricken in the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, dingchou: six hundred thousand hu of rice were lent to capital-region famine victims.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，帝白太后，欲元日先上太后壽乃受朝，太后不可。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: the emperor told the empress dowager he wished on New Year’s day first to offer her longevity wishes and only then receive court; the empress dowager would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, he asked to congratulate the dowager before holding New Year court; she refused.

sentences.zh: 王曾奏曰：「陛下以孝奉母儀，太后以謙全國體，請如太后令。」

translations.literal: Wang Zeng memorialized: “Your Majesty serves your mother with filial piety; the empress dowager completes the state’s dignity through modesty—please follow the empress dowager’s command.”
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zeng wrote: “Your Majesty honors your mother; the dowager preserves the realm through humility—obey her wish.”

sentences.zh: 五年春正月壬寅朔，初率百官上皇太后壽于會慶殿，遂御天安殿受朝。

translations.literal: Year five, spring, first month, day renyin new moon: for the first time he led officials to offer longevity wishes to the empress dowager in Assembly of Blessings Hall, then presided at Heavenly Peace Hall to receive court.
translations.idiomatic: Year five, new moon renyin: he first led the court in dowager longevity rites at Assembly of Blessings, then held New Year audience at Heavenly Peace.

sentences.zh: 己未，晏殊罷。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Yan Shu was removed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Yan Shu was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以夏竦為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Xia Song was made vice military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Xia Song became vice military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二月癸酉，命呂夷簡、夏竦修先朝國史，王曾提舉。

translations.literal: Second month, day guiyou: Lü Yijian and Xia Song were ordered to compile the previous reign’s national history; Wang Zeng was made supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, guiyou: Lü Yijian and Xia Song compiled the prior reign’s history under Wang Zeng.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔振京東流民。

translations.literal: Day bingzi, edict: eastern Jing refugees were to be relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, eastern Jing refugees received relief.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，西域僧法吉祥等來獻梵書。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: western-region monks including Fajixiang came to present Sanskrit books.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, western monks led by Fajixiang presented Sanskrit scriptures.

sentences.zh: 三月戊申，賜禮部奏名進士、諸科及第出身一千七十六人。

translations.literal: Third month, day wushen: 1,076 men who passed the Ministry of Rites examination and various subjects were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, wushen: 1,076 examination graduates received honors.

sentences.zh: 秦州地震。

translations.literal: Qin prefecture suffered earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: An earthquake struck Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 罷瓊州歲貢瑇瑁、龜皮、紫貝。

translations.literal: Qiong prefecture’s annual tribute of tortoiseshell, turtle hide, and purple cowries was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Qiong’s annual tribute of tortoiseshell, turtle hide, and cowries ended.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬辰，壽寧觀火。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day renchen: Shouning Observatory burned.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, renchen: Shouning Observatory burned.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己亥朔，振秦州水災，賜被溺家錢米。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jihai new moon: Qinzhou flood disaster was relieved; money and rice were given to drowned households.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, new moon jihai: Qin flood victims received money and rice.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，發丁夫三萬八千、卒二萬一千、緡錢五十萬塞滑州決河。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: 38,000 laborers, 21,000 soldiers, and fifty myriads of strings were dispatched to block Hua’s river breach.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, 38,000 laborers, 21,000 troops, and fifty myriads of cash sealed Hua’s breach.

sentences.zh: 詔察京東被災縣吏不職者以聞。

translations.literal: Edict: incompetent officials in eastern Jing disaster counties were to be investigated and reported.
translations.idiomatic: Incompetent officials in flooded eastern Jing counties were to be reported.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌，閱龍衛神勇軍習戰。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengxu: the Dragon Guard and Spirit Brave armies’ battle drill was reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, gengxu: Dragon Guard and Spirit Brave troops held a battle review.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛未，罷陝西青苗錢。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinwei: Shaanxi green-seed money was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, xinwei: Shaanxi green-seed loans ended.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，奉安真宗御容於慈孝寺崇真殿。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Zhenzong’s portrait was installed in the Spirit-Truth hall of Cixiao Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Zhenzong’s portrait entered Cixiao Temple’s Spirit-Truth hall.

sentences.zh: 己丑，頒新定《五服敕》。

translations.literal: Day jichou: the newly fixed Five Relations Edict was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, the revised Five Relations Edict was issued.

sentences.zh: 甲午，同皇太后幸御書院，觀太宗、真宗御書。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: together with the empress dowager he visited the Imperial Calligraphy Academy and viewed Taizong and Zhenzong’s imperial writings.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, he and the dowager toured the Imperial Calligraphy Academy to view Taizong and Zhenzong’s handwritings.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔西川、廣南在官物故者，遣人護送其家屬還鄉，官為給食。

translations.literal: Day yiwei, edict: when officials died in office in western Sichuan and Guangnan, someone was to escort their families home and the state was to supply food.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, families of officials who died in western Sichuan or Guangnan were escorted home at state expense.

sentences.zh: 丙申，滑州言河平。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Hua prefecture reported the river was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Hua reported the Yellow River was calm.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁酉朔，以陝西旱蝗，減其民租賦。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingyou new moon: because of Shaanxi drought and locusts, people’s rent and taxes were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, new moon dingyou: Shaanxi drought and locust victims got tax relief.

sentences.zh: 庚子，遣使河北體量安撫。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: envoys were sent to Hebei to assess and comfort.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, envoys went to Hebei to survey and comfort.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，復作指南車。

translations.literal: Day renyin: the south-pointing carriage was built again.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, artisans rebuilt the south-pointing carriage.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，朝饗景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: morning offerings were made at Spirit-Numinous Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, morning rites were held at Spirit-Numinous Palace.

sentences.zh: 壬子，饗太廟。

translations.literal: Day renzi: the ancestral temple was feasted.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the imperial ancestors were feasted.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，祀天地於圜丘，大赦。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to at the round altar; a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to at the round altar and the realm was amnestied.

sentences.zh: 賀皇太后于會慶殿。

translations.literal: Congratulations were offered to the empress dowager at Assembly of Blessings Hall.
translations.idiomatic: The dowager was congratulated at Assembly of Blessings Hall.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，恭謝玉清昭應宮。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: reverent thanks were offered at Jade Pure Manifest Response Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, thanks were offered at Jade Pure Manifest Response Palace.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，加恩百官。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinwei: added favors were bestowed on officials.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, xinwei: officials received added favors.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔輔臣南郊恩例外，更改一子官。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu, edict: tutor-ministers, beyond southern-suburb grace, were each to have one son’s office changed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, each tutor-minister could change one son’s office beyond southern-suburb grace.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔百官宗室受賂、冒為親屬奏官者毋赦。

translations.literal: Day dinghai, edict: officials and the imperial clan who took bribes or falsely claimed kin to obtain office were not to be amnestied.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, bribe-taking officials and clan members who bought offices through false kinship were excluded from amnesty.

sentences.zh: 是歲，甘州及南平國王李公蘊遣人來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ganzhou and Nanping king Li Gongyun sent people to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Ganzhou and Nanping’s Li Gongyun sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 京兆府、邢，洺州蝗。

translations.literal: Jingzhao prefecture, Xing, and Ming prefectures had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts struck Jingzhao, Xing, and Ming.

sentences.zh: 華州旱，虸蚄蟲食苗。

translations.literal: Hua prefecture suffered drought; mole-crickets ate the seedlings.
translations.idiomatic: Hua drought brought mole-crickets that devoured the seedlings.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月己酉，罷兩川乾元節歲貢織佛。

translations.literal: Year six, spring, first month, day jiyou: the two Sichuan circuits’ annual Qianyuan festival tribute of woven Buddhas was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Year six, first month, jiyou: Sichuan’s annual woven-Buddha Qianyuan tribute ended.

sentences.zh: 戊午，罷提點刑獄。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: judicial intendant-commissioners were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, judicial intendant-commissioners were abolished.

sentences.zh: 二月庚辰，大風，晝晦。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengchen: great wind; daylight turned dim.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, gengchen: a gale darkened the day.

sentences.zh: 壬午，張知白薨。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Zhang Zhibai died.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Zhang Zhibai died.

sentences.zh: 三月丙申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingshen new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, new moon bingshen: a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以張士遜同中書門下平章事、集賢殿大學士。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Zhang Shixun was made co-director of the Secretariat-Chancellery and grand academician of the Jixian Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Zhang Shixun joined the council with Jixian grand academician rank.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以薑遵為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Jiang Zun was made vice military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Jiang Zun became vice military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己未，以範雍為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Fan Yong was made vice military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Fan Yong became vice military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，作西太一宮。

translations.literal: Day renxu: the western Grand Unity Palace was built.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, the western Grand Unity Palace was built.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊辰，詔審官、三班院、吏部流內銓、軍頭司各引對所理公事。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuchen, edict: the Court of Review, third-rank court, flowing-within selection office, and army-head office were each to present and answer on the public business they handled.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, wuchen: review courts and selection offices had to present their caseloads in audience.

sentences.zh: 自帝為皇太子，輔臣參決諸司事於資善堂，至是始還有司。

translations.literal: Since the emperor had been crown prince, tutor-ministers had decided departmental affairs in the Hall of Cultivating Goodness; only now were matters returned to the proper offices.
translations.idiomatic: Since his crown-prince days tutors had ruled from the Hall of Cultivating Goodness; now business returned to the proper agencies.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，貸河北流民復業者種食，復是年租賦。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: seed and food were lent to Hebei refugees returning to their occupations, and that year’s rent and taxes were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Hebei refugees who returned to farming got seed loans and that year’s taxes forgiven.

sentences.zh: 癸未，命官減三司歲調上供物。

translations.literal: Day guimao: officials were ordered to reduce the three departments’ annual requisition of tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, officials were told to cut the three departments’ annual tribute requisitions.

sentences.zh: 甲申旦，有星大如鬥，自北流至西南，光燭地，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: At dawn on day jiashen a star as large as a dipper flowed from the north to the southwest; its light lit the ground and its sound was like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn on jiashen a dipper-sized fireball streaked north to southwest, lighting the earth with a thunderous roar.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，下德音，以星變齋居，不視事五日。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: a lenient edict was issued; because of the star omen he fasted and dwelt in seclusion, not handling affairs for five days.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, a lenient edict ordered five days of fasting and seclusion after the meteor.

sentences.zh: 降畿內囚死罪，流以下釋之。

translations.literal: Capital-region prisoners guilty of death were reduced; exile and below were released.
translations.idiomatic: Capital death sentences were commuted; exile and below were freed.

sentences.zh: 罷諸土木工。

translations.literal: All earthwork and timber projects were halted.
translations.idiomatic: All construction projects stopped.

sentences.zh: 振河北流民過京師者。

translations.literal: Hebei refugees passing through the capital were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei refugees passing the capital received relief.

sentences.zh: 五月乙未朔，交阯寇邊。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yiwei new moon: Jiaozhi raided the border.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, new moon yiwei: Jiaozhi raided the frontier.

sentences.zh: 六月丙寅，罷戎、瀘諸州谷稅錢。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingyin: grain-tax money at Rong, Lu, and related prefectures was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, bingyin: grain taxes at Rong, Lu, and related prefectures ended.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬子，江寧府、揚、真、潤州江水溢，壞官民廬舍，遣使安撫振恤。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renzi: the Yangtze overflowed at Jiangning prefecture and Yang, Zhen, and Run prefectures, destroying government and private buildings; envoys were sent to comfort and relieve.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, renzi: Yangtze floods wrecked Jiangning, Yang, Zhen, and Run; comfort envoys were sent.

sentences.zh: 八月乙丑，詔免河北水災州軍秋稅。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yichou, edict: autumn tax on Hebei flood-disaster prefectures was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, yichou: Hebei flood circuits were freed from autumn tax.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，河決澶州王楚埽。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the Yellow River burst at Wang Chu embankment in Dan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the Yellow River broke Wang Chu levee in Danzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，錄唐張九齡後。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: descendants of Tang’s Zhang Jiuling were enrolled.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Tang minister Zhang Jiuling’s descendants were registered.

sentences.zh: 九月己亥，詔京朝官任內，五人同罪奏舉者，減一任。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jihai, edict: when five capital officials in the same post jointly memorialized the same offense, their tenure was reduced one term.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jihai: five capital officials who jointly reported the same offense lost one tenure.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，祠西太一宮。

translations.literal: Day guimao: the western Grand Unity Palace was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, he sacrificed at the western Grand Unity Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔河北災傷，民質桑土與人者悉歸之，候歲豐償所貸。

translations.literal: Day jiachen, edict: in Hebei disaster areas, people who had pawned mulberry land were to have it all returned; when the year was abundant they would repay what was lent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Hebei disaster victims who pawned mulberry land got it back, to repay lenders after harvest.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，遣使修諸路兵械。

translations.literal: Day yisi: envoys were sent to repair military equipment on all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, envoys were sent to repair arms on every circuit.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲申，除福州民逋官莊錢十二萬八千緡。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiashen: twelve myriads eight thousand strings of Fuzhou people’s arrears on official estates were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, jiashen: Fuzhou’s twelve myriads eight thousand strings of official-estate debt were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊午，京西言谷鬥十錢。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuwu: the western capital reported grain at ten cash per dou.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, wuwu: the western capital reported grain at ten cash a dou— a bumper price.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，祠西太一宮。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guihai: the western Grand Unity Palace was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, guihai: he sacrificed again at the western Grand Unity Palace.

sentences.zh: 是歲，甘州、三佛齊來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ganzhou and Srivijaya came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Ganzhou and Srivijaya sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月癸卯，曹利用罷。

translations.literal: Year seven, spring, first month, day guimao: Cao Liyong was removed.
translations.idiomatic: Year seven, first month, guimao: Cao Liyong was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，降利用為左千牛衛上將軍。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Liyong was demoted to left Thousand-Ox Guards senior general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Liyong was demoted to senior general of the left Thousand-Ox Guards.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申朔，魯宗道卒。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengshen new moon: Lu Zongdao died.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, new moon gengshen: Lu Zongdao died.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔文臣曆邊有材勇、武臣之子有節義者，與換官，三路任使。

translations.literal: Day jiazi, edict: civil officials who had served on the frontier with talent and courage, and sons of military officials with integrity, were to exchange offices and be assigned on the three frontier circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, proven frontier civilists and worthy sons of generals could swap offices for frontier posts.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，張士遜罷，以呂夷簡同中書門下平章事、集賢殿大學士。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Zhang Shixun was removed; Lü Yijian was made co-director of the Secretariat-Chancellery and grand academician of the Jixian Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Zhang Shixun fell and Lü Yijian joined the council with Jixian rank.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以夏竦、薛奎參知政事，陳堯佐為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Xia Song and Xue Kui were made participating administrators; Chen Yaozuo was made vice military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Xia Song and Xue Kui entered the council; Chen Yaozuo became vice military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，貶曹利用為崇信軍節度副使、房州安置，未至，自殺。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Cao Liyong was demoted to Chongxin circuit military vice commissioner and assigned to Fangzhou; before he arrived he killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Cao Liyong was banished to Fangzhou; he killed himself en route.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以河北水災，委轉運使察官吏，不任職者易之。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: because of Hebei flood disaster, transport commissioners were entrusted to investigate officials; incompetent ones were replaced.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Hebei transport commissioners were to replace incompetent flood officials.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸巳，募民入粟以振河北。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day guisi: the people were recruited to contribute grain to relieve Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, guisi: civilians were asked to donate grain for Hebei relief.

sentences.zh: 戊申，禁京城創造寺觀。

translations.literal: Day wushen: building temples and observances in the capital was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, new temples in the capital were banned.

sentences.zh: 壬子，復製舉六科，增高蹈丘園、沉淪草澤、茂才異等科，置書判拔萃科及試武舉。

translations.literal: Day renzi: the six special examination subjects were restored; the lofty-reclusion, sunken-in-grass, and outstanding-talent subjects were raised, the document-judgment outstanding subject and military examination were established.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, six special examinations returned, elevated reclusion and talent subjects, and added document-judgment and military tests.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，置理檢使，以御史中丞為之。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: rectification inspectors were established, with the censor-in-chief as holder.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, rectification inspectors were created under the censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，詔吏胥受賕毋用蔭。

translations.literal: Third month, day yichou, edict: clerks who took bribes could not use yin privilege.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, yichou: bribe-taking clerks lost yin privilege.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔契丹饑民所過給米，分送唐、鄧等州，以閒田處之。

translations.literal: Day xinsi, edict: Khitan famine refugees along the route were to be given rice and sent in groups to Tang, Deng, and other prefectures to be settled on idle land.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, starving Khitan refugees received rice and were settled on idle land in Tang, Deng, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔百官轉對，極言時政闕失，在外者實封以聞。

translations.literal: Day guimao, edict: officials were to rotate in audience and speak fully on current policy failures; those outside the capital were to seal memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, officials had to speak frankly on policy failures in rotation; outsiders used sealed memorials.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚寅，赦天下，免河北被水民租賦。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengyin: the empire was amnestied; rent and taxes of Hebei flood victims were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, gengyin: the realm was amnestied and Hebei flood rents forgiven.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，南平王李公蘊卒，其子德政遣人來告，以為交阯郡王。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Nanping king Li Gongyun died; his son Dezheng sent envoys to announce it; he was made king of Jiaozhi commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Nanping’s Li Gongyun died; his son Dezheng was made king of Jiaozhi commandery.

sentences.zh: 五月乙未朔，詔禮部貢舉。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yiwei new moon, edict: the Ministry of Rites civil examination.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, new moon yiwei: the Ministry of Rites examination was ordered.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔戒文弊。

translations.literal: Day gengshen, edict: literary excess was warned against.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, the court warned against florid writing.

sentences.zh: 己巳，頒新令。

translations.literal: Day jisi: the new statutes were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the new statutes were issued.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔先朝文武官自刺史、少卿、監以上，並錄其後。

translations.literal: Day gengwu, edict: civil and military officials of the previous reign from prefect and vice-minister and commissioner upward were all to have their descendants recorded.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, descendants of prior-reign officials of prefect rank and above were to be registered.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，錄系囚。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，御承明殿，臣僚請對者十九人，日昃乃罷。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: he presided at Chenming Hall; nineteen officials requested audience; court ended at sundown.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, nineteen officials sought audience at Chenming Hall until sundown.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，置益、梓、廣南路轉運判官。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renchen: transport vice-commissioners for Yi, Zi, and Guangnan circuits were established.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, renchen: transport vice-commissioners were set up for Yi, Zi, and Guangnan.

sentences.zh: 丁未，大雷雨，玉清昭應宮災。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: great thunder and rain; the Jade Pure Manifest Response Palace burned.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, lightning burned Jade Pure Manifest Response Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，王曾罷。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Wang Zeng was removed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Wang Zeng was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸亥，以玉清昭應宮災，遣官告諸陵，詔天下不復繕修。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guihai: because of the Jade Pure Manifest Response Palace fire, officials were sent to announce at the tombs; an edict ordered no more repairs empire-wide.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, guihai: after the Jade Pure fire, tomb announcers were sent and empire-wide shrine repairs were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔殿直以上毋得換文資。

translations.literal: Day yihai, edict: from palace-director rank upward, exchange to civil qualification was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, palace-directors and above could not switch to civil rank.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，罷諸宮觀使。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: all palace-observance commissioners were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, palace-observance commissioners were abolished.

sentences.zh: 八月丁亥朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dinghai new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, new moon dinghai: a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 詔罷天下職田，官收其入，以所直均給之。

translations.literal: Edict: office fields empire-wide were abolished; the state collected their income and distributed its value equally.
translations.idiomatic: Office fields empire-wide were abolished; income was pooled and paid out equally.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以呂夷簡為昭文館大學士。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Lü Yijian was made grand academician of the Zhaowen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Lü Yijian became Zhaowen grand academician.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，夏竦復為樞密副使，陳堯佐、王曙並參知政事。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Xia Song again became vice military affairs commissioner; Chen Yaozuo and Wang Shu were both made participating administrators.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Xia Song returned as vice military commissioner; Chen Yaozuo and Wang Shu joined the council.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔命官犯正入贓，毋使親民。

translations.literal: Day jihai, edict: when appointed officials were convicted of capital graft, they were not to be sent to govern the people.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, officials guilty of capital graft could not be sent to govern civilians.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬寅，閱虎翼武騎卒習戰。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renyin: the Tiger Wing martial cavalry’s battle drill was reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, renyin: Tiger Wing cavalry held a battle review.

sentences.zh: 丙午，京師地震。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: the capital suffered earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, the capital shook in an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 詔知州軍歲舉判、司、簿、尉可縣令者一人。

translations.literal: Edict: each year military prefects were to recommend one judge, clerk, registrar, or constable fit to be county magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Each year prefects had to name one subordinate fit for county magistrate.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸亥，冬至，率百官上皇太后壽于會慶殿，遂御天安殿受朝。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guihai: on the winter solstice he led officials to offer longevity wishes to the empress dowager at Assembly of Blessings Hall, then presided at Heavenly Peace Hall to receive court.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, guihai: winter solstice brought dowager longevity rites at Assembly of Blessings, then audience at Heavenly Peace.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔天下孤獨疾病者，致醫藥存視。

translations.literal: Day gengwu, edict: the empire’s solitary, orphaned, ill, and infirm were to receive medicine and care.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the lonely, orphaned, sick, and poor were to receive medical care.

sentences.zh: 詔周世宗後，凡經郊祀，錄其子孫一人。

translations.literal: Edict: after each suburban sacrifice, one descendant of Later Zhou Shizong was to be enrolled.
translations.idiomatic: After every suburban sacrifice, one Later Zhou Shizong descendant was enrolled.

sentences.zh: 是歲，河北水。

translations.literal: That year, Hebei suffered flood.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei flooded that year.

sentences.zh: 遣使決囚，振貧，瘞溺死者，給其家緡錢，察官吏貪暴不恤民者。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to decide prisoners, relieve the poor, bury the drowned, give their families strings of cash, and investigate officials who were greedy, violent, and did not pity the people.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys judged prisoners, aided the poor, buried the drowned, paid grieving families, and exposed cruel officials.

sentences.zh: 龜茲、下溪州黔州蠻來貢。

translations.literal: Kucha, Lower Creek in Qian, and Qianzhou barbarians came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Kucha, Lower Creek, and Qianzhou tribes sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月甲戌，曹瑋卒。

translations.literal: Year eight, spring, first month, day jiaxu: Cao Wei died.
translations.idiomatic: Year eight, first month, jiaxu: Cao Wei died.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，作會聖宮於西京永安縣。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Assembly of Sagely Palace was built in Yongan county of the western capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Assembly of Sagely Palace rose in Luoyang’s Yongan county.

sentences.zh: 二月戊子，詔五代時官三品以上告身存者，子孫聽用蔭。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuzi, edict: when appointment patents of fifth-dynasty officials of third rank and above still survived, descendants were permitted to use yin privilege.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, wuzi: descendants with surviving fifth-dynasty patents of rank 3+ could use yin privilege.

sentences.zh: 三月壬申，幸後苑，遂宴太清樓。

translations.literal: Third month, day renshen: he visited the rear garden and then feasted at the Great Clarity tower.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, renshen: he toured the rear garden and feasted at Great Clarity tower.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，禁以財冒士族娶宗室女者。

translations.literal: Day yihai: using wealth to pass as gentry in marrying imperial-clan daughters was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, rich parvenus could not marry imperial-clan daughters.

sentences.zh: 詔河北被水州縣毋稅牛。

translations.literal: Edict: flooded Hebei prefectures and counties were not to tax oxen.
translations.idiomatic: Flooded Hebei counties were barred from taxing oxen.

sentences.zh: 是月，賜禮部奏名進士、諸科及第出身八百二十二人。

translations.literal: That month, 822 men who passed the Ministry of Rites examination and various subjects were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: That month, 822 examination graduates received honors.

sentences.zh: 五月甲寅，賜信州龍虎山張乾曜號澄素先生。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiayin: Zhang Qianyao of Dragon-Tiger Mountain in Xin prefecture was given the style Master Pure-Simple.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jiayin: Xinzhou Dragon-Tiger Mountain’s Zhang Qianyao became Master Pure-Simple.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，大雨雹。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: great rain and hail.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, hailstorms struck.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，錄系囚。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the court reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 六月癸巳，呂夷簡上新修國史。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guisi: Lü Yijian submitted the newly revised national history.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, guisi: Lü Yijian presented the revised national history.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔御史台獄勿關糾察司。

translations.literal: Day jihai, edict: Censorate prison cases were not to involve the Inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Censorate detainees were barred from Inspectorate review.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，親試書判拔萃科及武舉人。

translations.literal: Day yisi: the emperor personally examined the Exceptional Judgment and Selection degree candidates and military examination candidates.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, he personally tested the Judgment-and-Selection finalists and military examinees.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙子，策制舉人。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day bingzi: policy examination for classical recruitment candidates.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, bingzi: special-recruitment candidates faced the policy exam.

sentences.zh: 八月丙戌，詔詳定鹽法。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingxu, edict: the salt law was to be reviewed in detail.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, bingxu: a full review of the salt statutes was ordered.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔近臣宗室觀祖宗御書于龍圖、天章閣，又觀瑞谷於元真殿，遂宴蕊珠殿。

translations.literal: Day dinghai, edict: close ministers and the imperial clan were to view the ancestors’ imperial writings at the Longtu and Tianzhang pavilions, also view the auspicious grain at Yuanzhen Hall, and then banquet at Ruizhu Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, kin and intimate ministers toured imperial calligraphy in the Longtu and Tianzhang pavilions, inspected the auspicious grain at Yuanzhen Hall, and feasted in Ruizhu Hall.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔流配人道死者，其妻子給食送還鄉里。

translations.literal: Day wuzi, edict: when exiled convicts died en route, their wives and children were given food and sent back to their native districts.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, families of convicts who died in exile were fed and escorted home.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，復置諸路提點刑獄官。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guichou: circuit intendants for punishments were re-established.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, guichou: circuit punishment intendants were restored.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，罷轉對。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: rotating remonstrance audiences were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, rotating palace remonstrance was ended.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，薑遵卒。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Jiang Zun died.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Jiang Zun died.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以趙稹為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Zhao Zhen was made vice military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Zhao Zhen became vice military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬辰，奉安太祖御容于太平興國寺開先殿。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renchen: Taizu’s imperial portrait was installed at Kaixian Hall of Taiping Xingguo Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, renchen: Taizu’s portrait was enshrined at Taiping Xingguo Temple’s Kaixian Hall.

sentences.zh: 丙申，弛三京、河中府、潁、許、汝、鄭、鄆、濟、衛、晉、絳、虢、亳、宿等二十八州軍鹽禁。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: salt restrictions were relaxed in the three capitals, Hezhong prefecture, and twenty-eight prefectures and armies including Ying, Xu, Ru, Zheng, Yun, Ji, Wei, Jin, Jiang, Guo, Bo, and Su.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the salt monopoly was lifted across the three capitals, Hezhong, and twenty-eight prefectures from Ying and Xu to Bo and Su.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，置天章閣待制。
