translations.literal: Day renyin: Tianzhang Pavilion attendant compilers were established.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Tianzhang Pavilion attendant compilers were created.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙寅，朝饗景靈宮。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingyin: morning offering at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, bingyin: morning rites at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，饗太廟。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: offering at the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, he offered at the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，祀天地於圜丘，大赦。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to at the Round Mound; a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, he sacrificed at the Round Mound and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 賀皇太后于會慶殿。

translations.literal: The empress dowager was congratulated at Huiqing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: He congratulated the dowager at Huiqing Hall.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸未，加恩百官。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guiwei: additional favors were granted to all officials.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, guiwei: all officials received added favors.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，西平王趙德明、交阯王李德政並加賜功臣。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Western Pacification King Zhao Deming and Jiaozhi King Li Dezheng both received additional merit-title bestowals.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Zhao Deming of Western Pacification and Li Dezheng of Jiaozhi each gained a further merit title.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高麗、占城、邛部川都蠻來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Goryeo, Champa, and the Qiongbu River chieftains came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Goryeo, Champa, and Qiongbu River tribes sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月辛亥，詔諸路轉運判官員外郎以上，遇郊聽任子弟。

translations.literal: Ninth year, spring, first month, day xinhai, edict: circuit transport deputies at assistant minister rank and above, on suburban sacrifice, might let their sons take office.
translations.idiomatic: Year nine, first month, xinhai: transport deputies ranked assistant minister or higher could place a son in office at the suburban rite.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，長寧節，百官初上皇太后壽于會慶殿。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: on the Long Peace festival, officials for the first time offered longevity wishes to the empress dowager at Huiqing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Long Peace brought the first dowager longevity rites at Huiqing Hall.

sentences.zh: 辛未，減畿內民租。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: capital-region land tax was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, capital-region land tax was cut.

sentences.zh: 二月癸巳，詔復郡縣職田。

translations.literal: Second month, day guisi, edict: commandery and county office fields were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, guisi: commandery and county office fields were revived.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅，奉安太祖、太宗、真宗御容于會聖宮。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiayin: Taizu, Taizong, and Zhenzong’s imperial portraits were installed at Huisheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiayin: Taizu, Taizong, and Zhenzong were enshrined at Huisheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊寅，詔以隴州論平民五人為劫盜抵死，主者雖更赦，並從重罰。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuyin, edict: because Longzhou had sentenced five commoners to death as robbers, even if the responsible officials received amnesty, they would still be punished severely.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, wuyin: after Longzhou executed five civilians as bandits, responsible officials faced harsh punishment even through amnesty.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，閱大樂。

translations.literal: Day yisi: the great music was reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, the court reviewed the great music.

sentences.zh: 五月乙丑，錄系囚。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yichou: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, yichou: prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 六月庚辰，宋綬上《皇太后儀制》。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengchen: Song Shou submitted the “Empress Dowager Protocol.”
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, gengchen: Song Shou presented the Empress Dowager Protocol.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙午朔，契丹使來告其主隆緒殂，遣使祭奠吊慰，及賀宗真立。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, new moon bingwu: Khitan envoys announced that their ruler Longxu had died; envoys were sent to mourn and console, and to congratulate Zongzhen’s accession.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, new moon bingwu: Khitan envoys reported Longxu’s death; Song sent mourners and congratulations for Zongzhen’s enthronement.

sentences.zh: 九月癸亥，祠西太一宮，賜道左耕者茶帛。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guihai: sacrifice at the Western Grand Unity Palace; tea and cloth were given to farmers along the road.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, guihai: he sacrificed at Western Grand Unity Palace and gave tea and cloth to roadside farmers.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙戌，詔公卿大夫勵名節。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingxu, edict: high ministers were to cultivate name and integrity.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, bingxu: grandees were urged to guard reputation and principle.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔常參官已授外任，毋得奏舉選人。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: officials who regularly attended court but had already received outside appointments were forbidden from memorializing nominations for selection-office candidates.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, court regulars already posted abroad could no longer nominate selection-office candidates.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，罷益、梓、廣南路轉運判官。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: transport deputies for the Yi, Zi, and Guangnan circuits were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Yi, Zi, and Guangnan transport deputies were abolished.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊辰，翰林侍讀學士孫奭請老，命知兗州，曲宴太清樓送之。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day wuchen: Hanlin attendant reader Sun Shi requested retirement; he was ordered to govern Yanzhou; a special banquet at Taiqing Tower sent him off.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, wuchen: Sun Shi retired to Yanzhou after a farewell banquet in Taiqing Tower.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁亥，馳兩川礬禁。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dinghai: alum restrictions in the two Shu circuits were lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, dinghai: the two Shu alum monopoly was lifted.

sentences.zh: 己丑，祈雪於會靈觀。

translations.literal: Day jichou: snow was prayed for at Huiling Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, the court prayed for snow at Huiling Abbey.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，出知雜御史曹修古，御史郭勸、楊偕，推直官段少連。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: investigating censor Cao Xiugu, censors Guo Quan and Yang Jie, and investigating clerk Duan Shaolian were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Cao Xiugu, Guo Quan, Yang Jie, and investigating clerk Duan Shaolian were ousted.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲寅，詔吏部銓選人父母年八十以上者，權注近官。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiayin, edict: when Board of Civil Office selection candidates had parents eighty or older, they were provisionally assigned nearby posts.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiayin: selectors with parents over eighty were provisionally posted nearby.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，大風三日。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: great wind for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, a gale lasted three days.

sentences.zh: 是歲，契丹主及其國母遣使來致遺留物及謝弔祭。

translations.literal: That year, the Khitan ruler and his nation’s mother sent envoys to deliver leftover goods and thank for condolence sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Khitan emperor and empress dowager sent leftover gifts and thanks for mourning rites.

sentences.zh: 南平王李德政遣人謝加恩。

translations.literal: Nanping King Li Dezheng sent men to thank for the additional favor.
translations.idiomatic: Nanping’s Li Dezheng sent envoys to thank for the added honors.

sentences.zh: 龜茲、沙州來貢。

translations.literal: Kucha and Shazhou came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Kucha and Shazhou sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 女真晏端等百八十四人內附。

translations.literal: One hundred eighty-four Jurchen including Yan Duan and others submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: 184 Jurchen led by Yan Duan came in.
